local p = {}
local data = {
	misc = mw.loadData('Module:Glossary/misc'),
	narrative = mw.loadData('Module:Glossary/narrative'),
}
local colorMap = {
	[0] = "#fff200", --endfield yellow
	[1] = "#DFBB92", --bronze/physical
	[2] = "cyan",
	[3] = "white",
	[4] = "#FF853F", --legally distinct red/fire
	[5] = "#00C0CB", --ice blue
	[6] = "#9CD54A", --nature green
	[7] = "#FDC038", --electric yellow/soft orange
	[8] = "#ABD040", --healing green
	[9] = "#33C2FF", --keyword / arts blue
	[10] = "#FFAE6B", --stagger orange
}
local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local yesno = require('Module:Yesno')

function p.main(frame)
	local args = getArgs(frame, {
		wrappers = 'Template:Glossary'
	})
	return p._main(args)
end

function p._main(args)
	local key = args[1]
	
	local tokens = {}
	for token in string.gmatch(key, "([^,]+)") do
		token = mw.text.trim(token)
		if token ~= "" then
			table.insert(tokens, token)
		end
	end
	
	local container = mw.html.create('')
	
	for i, token in ipairs(tokens) do
		if i > 1 then
			container:wikitext(', ')
		end
		local obj

		for _, m in pairs(data) do
			obj = m[token]
			if obj then break end
		end
	
		if not obj then
			container:wikitext('<i>Term "<code>'..token..'</code>" not found in glossary</i>')
		else
			local name = obj.name
			local title = obj.title
			local desc = obj.desc
			local link = obj.link
			local icon = obj.icon or ''
			local colorNum = tonumber(obj.color)
			local textColor = colorNum and colorMap[colorNum]
			local pagename = link or name
			local text = args[2] or name or token or title
			--if icon then text = icon .. text end
			local nolink = yesno(args.nolink)
			
			local attrs = {
				['data-name'] = name,
				['data-title'] = title,
				['data-color'] = obj.color,
				['data-desc'] = desc,
			}
			
			local stooltip = container:tag('span')
				:addClass('glossary')
				:attr(attrs)
				:css('text-decoration', 'underline')
		
			if textColor then
				stooltip:css('color', textColor)
			end
		
			if nolink or link == 'none' then
				stooltip:wikitext(icon .. text)
			else
				stooltip:wikitext(icon .. '[[' .. pagename .. '|' .. '<span style="color:' .. textColor .. '">' .. text .. '</span>]]')
			end
		end
		
	end	

	return container
end

return p
